purpose.domain_detail: VISA issuer file build utility; reads a text flat file and writes to an ISAM indexed file for issuer records
purpose.summary: This program builds an ISAM indexed file for VISA issuer data. It reads records from a sequential text input file (ISS-FILE-TXT) and writes them to an indexed output file (ISS-FILE), counting records processed and displaying completion status.

notable_features: ISAM file handling via SELECT/FD copybooks
PERFORM UNTIL loop with AT END / NOT AT END
WRITE ... BEFORE ADVANCING (print-style write on indexed file)
Dual-author header comment with two dates
verdict.notes: No IDENTIFICATION DIVISION header present (PROGRAM-ID appears standalone); missing IDENTIFICATION DIVISION keyword is unusual. The G3 prefix and dual student names suggest an academic project. Dialect is uncertain; GnuCOBOL is a reasonable guess for a student environment but cannot be confirmed from source alone. The WRITE ... BEFORE ADVANCING on an indexed file is unusual and may indicate a coding error or non-standard extension.
